# reselling_database_plans (Data Source)

Active managed database plans with your monthly price, and the engine versions that can be ordered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_database_plans" "all" {}

output "engines" {
  value = data.reselling_database_plans.all.engines
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only plans whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `engines` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines))
- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--engines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines`

Read-Only:

- `engine` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `version` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `memory_mb` (Number)
- `monthly_price` (Number) Your monthly price in EUR.
- `name` (String)
